modules.module_title: Taking charge of shift from Ring frame doffer

pcs.pc_description: reach the work place at least 10 - 15 minutes early
bring the necessary operational tools to the department
understand the count produced, colour coding, followed in the ring frames

meet the previous shift doffer and discuss with him/ her regarding the schedule of doffing activities to be carried out in ring frame department, and issues faced with respect to the quality, production, spare, safety or any other specific instruction etc.
ensure the technical details are mentioned in the display board in the ring frame machine
check the availability of empty cops and fill the empty cop trolley and ensure colour coding and technical details mentioned
ensure proper functioning of cop trolleys
check the condition of empty cops in cop trolleys
ensure proper functioning of ring frame machine parts
check whether any spare/raw material/ tool / yarn / any other material are thrown under the machines or in the other work areas.
ask the previous shift doffer for any deviation in the above and bring the same to the knowledge of his/ her shift superior and the superior of the previous shift as well.
ensure the wastes collection boxes are empty while taking charge of shift
ensure that the workplace is clean
take over the shift from the outgoing shifts ring frame doffer in a proper manner

modules.module_title: Handing over shift to Ring frame doffer

pcs.pc_description: convey information effectively and confirm understanding. Provide the details regarding count produced, colour coding followed in the ring frames and prepare schedule for carrying out doffing activities
get clearance from the incoming counterpart before leaving the work spot
report to his/ her shift superior and the incoming shift doffer in case his/ her counterpart does not report for the incoming shift
ensure the shift is properly handed over to the incoming shift doffer

report to his/ her shift superior about the quality / production / safety issues/ any other issue faced in his/ her shift and should leave the department only after getting concurrence for the same from his/ her superior
ensure that the work spot is clean
ensure proper cleaning after lot change and count change

modules.module_title: Identify the machine for carrying out doffing

pcs.pc_description: follow the plan as instructed by superior for performing doffing activities at various machines in ring frame department
patrol and identify which machine in ring frame departments is ready for doffing
ensure minimum time is taken for identifying the machine on which doffing activity is to be carried out
ensure in confirming the machine with the superiors for carrying out doffing activity

modules.module_title: Collecting the empty cops from storage area and loading in cop trolley

pcs.pc_description: identify the empty cops required for next doff and segregate it according to size and colour code
ensure the cops are clean
clean the empty cops and remove the yarn remnants, if needed
remove the collected waste and store it in a waste collection box
ensure that the empty cops are in good condition
remove the damaged cops and store in a separate place
ensure that an empty cop of correct size and colour code is loaded in the bobbin trolley
ensure proper material handling of empty cops
load the empty cops in the cop trolley in an organised manner
load the required number of empty cops as per requirement in different cop trolleys
move and arrange the cop trolleys in an organised manner near the ring frame machine in which doffing activity is to be carried out
ensure minimum time is taken for carrying the above activities
ensure that overhead blower is parked at one side of the machine during doffing
overhead blower should start as soon as the doffed machine starts

modules.module_title: Support in preparing the creel zone in case of Lot change

pcs.pc_description: support the tenter in bringing new bobbins from the speed frame department to the ring frame filling zone at the time of lot change as per instruction from the superiors
to ensure correct roving bobbins are taken for filling
creel the roving bobbins in the reserve umbrella creel as instructed by superiors
ensure proper material handling of bobbin and bobbin trolley
keep the roving waste in the waste collection pocket provided to each operator and then put in the waste collection box
ensure minimum time is taken for filling the roving bobbin
discuss with the supervisor on a timely basis for clarifications if any
ensure cleanliness at work place

stop the machine

modules.module_title: Responsibilities while working in auto doffer ring frame

pcs.pc_description: ensure there is no empties or full cop under the doffing unit
ensure empty ring tubes are ready in all c channel peg tray before the machine reaches the doff length
ensure there is no empties or full cops found under the doffing unit to avoid any stuck up
ensure empty ring tubes are loaded fully in the tube loader reserve box before doffing is started.
ensure doffing person reaches the machine for gaiting work before starting the doffing activity
ensure doff trolleys are kept in the off end in a specified position.
ensure that doffing process is functioning properly without any malfunction.
ensure that after doffing gaiting to be done properly and timely
ensure that all the full cops are removed from the spindles and empties are loaded in spindles during doffing to avoid yarn wound on empty spindle.
ensure that all the grippers in the doffing unit are available in position without missing during doffing.
ensure that there is no air leakage in the grippers.
ensure the wastes collected from different parts of machine are deposited in the respective dustbins
ensure the ring frame department is neat and clean
verify the proper build of the ring cop
record the production details in the production report
report to the supervisor in case of emergency stoppage of machine
support the tenter and maintenance team for carrying out cleaning activities, on need basis
support the maintenance team while machine is under maintenance
ensure all details related to production are provided to the next shift doffer while relieving
